summary:
Our project, Electra, is an interactive game designed to introduce players to the exciting world of space exploration. We developed a rocket flight game where players can experience the concept of launching and exploring space through gameplay.

Our project addresses the challenge by making space missions more interesting and easier to understand through an interactive gaming experience. Instead of only learning about space missions through reading, players can explore the idea of rocket launches in a virtual environment.

This project is important because it encourages curiosity, creativity and interest in space exploration. It also helps players understand how games can be used as an educational tool to make learning about space technology more engaging and enjoyable.
details:
Our project is a rocket flight game developed using Roblox Studio. It allows players to experience a virtual space mission and explore the concept of rocket flight in an interactive environment.

The game uses coding and scripting to create its gameplay features and provide an enjoyable experience for players. One of its main benefits is that it makes learning about space exploration more interesting and engaging.

We used Roblox Studio and Lua scripting to develop our project. Our creativity comes from combining gaming and space exploration to create an interactive learning experience. During development, our team considered the space mission theme, gameplay experience, creativity and how to make the game enjoyable and easy to understand.

The intended impact of our project is to inspire more people, especially young learners, to become interested in space exploration, rocket technology and science.
